scripts.dev: bun run audio && bun run film:optimize && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: bun run audio && remotion still src/index.ts
scripts.stills: bun run audio && bun scripts/check.ts stills
scripts.render: bun run audio && remotion render src/index.ts scene-open out/open.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16
scripts.render:hero: bun run audio && remotion render src/index.ts hero out/hero-16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow --concurrency=4 --timeout=240000 --gl=angle
scripts.render:cutdown: bun run audio && remotion render src/index.ts cutdown-vertical out/cutdown-9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow --timeout=240000 --gl=angle
scripts.render:loop: remotion render src/index.ts loop-readme out/loop-60.mp4 --crf=16 --scale=0.5 --muted && bun scripts/encode-loop.ts
scripts.render:gif: bun run audio && remotion render src/index.ts scene-open out/open.gif --every-nth-frame=3 --scale=0.5
